# ClosedLoop_Neuromodulation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A control framework that uses real-time neural state estimates to apply targeted perturbations (neuromodulation) to steer the brain's non-equilibrium dynamics toward desired regimes. Critical for adaptive brain-computer interfaces and therapeutic interventions, leveraging TCC's topology-aware communication to deliver precise, low-latency feedback.
